shared_elements: round-topped upright slab/stele shape with figural scene above and script below
register at top containing human figures
dense inscription in a non-Latin script filling the lower field
framing border along the edges of the field
justification: Both are round-topped upright monuments divided into an upper figural panel with small profile human figures and a much larger lower field densely filled with script, with a border framing the field — a generic monument scheme rather than a shared motif set. The specific content differs entirely: A shows a winged disc, seated and standing deities with staffs and offering gestures in a single narrow register above many ruled horizontal lines of pictographic signs, while B shows a horse with rider(s), a spear, and large interlaced ribbon/serpent knots with runic-type characters running along curving borders, not in ruled horizontal lines.
